Long, flowing ocean-blue hair with straight bangs and a silky texture. Large, gentle sapphire-blue eyes with a soft, serene expression. Apparent age is early twenties with a mature, graceful countenance. Slender build wearing a white and translucent blue aquatic-themed dress with gold accents and a large blue ribbon. Features long, iridescent blue fish-like fins extending from the head and a long, shimmering blue aquatic tail.
BODY COLOR: pale skin and ocean-blue accents
